description: This file contains the implementation of checkDBSettings() function that validates database configuration inputs during the setup process of SuiteCRM. It performs validation on user-provided database connection details, checks database existence, and manages session variables related to database setup.

methods.name: checkDBSettings
methods.description: Validates database connection and configuration inputs, checks database existence, and ensures user rights for the SuiteCRM installation process.

methods.name: printErrors
methods.description: Outputs validation errors or success message based on the validation results.

methods.name: copyInputsIntoSession
methods.description: Copies user input from request variables into session variables for persistent configuration state.
